name: 開物 Kaiwu
description: Chinese-world web search API for AI agents: uncensored sources, Traditional/Simplified query expansion, LLM-ready results, hosted in Taiwan. 專為 AI agent 打造的中文搜尋 API。
when_to_use: The user's question concerns Taiwan, Hong Kong, China or the Chinese-speaking web and English search APIs return sparse or Simplified-only results.
The same concept has different Traditional and Simplified terms; Kaiwu expands both automatically.
You need uncensored results on topics filtered by mainland search engines.
You need clean page content (markdown) rather than snippets: search_depth=advanced or POST /v1/extract.
You need an answer with cited sources: include_answer=true.
